rule.name: OptionalOrElseGetNull
rule.message: orElseGet(null) passes a null Supplier: it compiles, but throws a NullPointerException as soon as the Optional is empty. Use orElse(null) when a null result is meant (and check it where it is used), orElseGet(() -> fallback()) for a computed default, or orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException(id)) when absence is an error.
